about.title: Clinic first,
about.p1: I work in interdisciplinary settings and have supported people with disabilities in Mexico and the United States. That practice shapes what I want to build: clarity, evidence and real support in rehabilitation.
about.p2: Looking ahead, I want to keep bringing clinical care and applied AI together: tools that help records and care, in service of professional judgment.

faq.title: About
faq.lead: Short answers on role, training and how I use technology in health.
faq.q1: Who is Ulises Antonio Ponce Pretelin?
faq.a1: A physical therapist in Xalapa, Veracruz. He combines clinical care and inclusion (Mexico and the U.S.) with digital tools and applied AI for rehabilitation.
faq.a2: Physical Therapy degree (ICES, Xalapa) and Information Technologies in Sciences studies (ENES Morelia, UNAM), plus ongoing Anthropic/Claude, MCP and agents training.
faq.q3: How does he combine clinical care and technology?
faq.a3: He starts from clinical reasoning and evidence. Technology supports records, safety and workflows; it does not diagnose or replace the professional.
faq.a4: One of my projects: a clinical manager for physical therapy, with its own demo. This portfolio is about Ulises; the product lives in its demo.
